name: Mastiff
otherStatistics: Str +1, Dex +2, Con +1, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -2. Perception 11. Stealth 12. No special senses. Languages none.
appearance: A muscular fawn mastiff with a broad dark muzzle and dropped ears.

sections.Printed source: Cubil de Monstruos, licensed Nosolorol Spanish edition of Monster Vault, p. 347. Entry heading “Mastín”. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits: Heightened Hearing and Smell. Perception rises to 16 when relying on hearing or smell.
sections.Actions: Bite. Make a melee weapon attack at +4 against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. A creature hit must pass a DC 12 Strength save or fall Prone.
sections.Reactions: Protect Friend. When a creature within 5 ft. of the mastiff hits a friendly Humanoid the mastiff can see with an attack, the mastiff may make one Bite attack against the attacker.

name: Mule
otherStatistics: Str +2, Dex +0, Con +1, Int -4, Wis +0, Cha -3. Perception 10. Stealth 10. No special senses. Resistant to Exhaustion and Prone. Languages none.
appearance: A brown mule with upright ears, a pale muzzle and short dark mane.

sections.Printed source: Cubil de Monstruos, licensed Nosolorol Spanish edition of Monster Vault, pp. 347–348. Entry heading “Mula”. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits: Beast of Burden. Treat the mule as Large when determining carrying capacity.
sections.Actions: Hooves. Make a melee weapon attack at +4 against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) bludgeoning damage.

name: Octopus
otherStatistics: Str -3, Dex +1, Con +0, Int -4, Wis +0, Cha -3. Perception 12. Stealth 13. Darkvision 30 ft. Languages none.
appearance: An octopus with a rounded mantle and curling, sucker-lined arms.

sections.Printed source: Cubil de Monstruos, licensed Nosolorol Spanish edition of Monster Vault, p. 351. Entry heading “Pulpo”. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. Outside water, the octopus can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
Underwater Camouflage. Underwater, its Stealth score is 18.
Water Breathing. The octopus breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions: Tentacles. Make a melee weapon attack at +3 against one target within 5 ft. A hit deals 3 (1d4 + 1) bludgeoning damage. A Medium or smaller creature hit is Grappled (escape DC 11). Until that grapple ends, the octopus cannot use Tentacles against another target.
sections.Reactions: Ink Dash (Recharge 6). When a creature the octopus can see damages it, the octopus can release a 5-ft.-radius cloud of ink centered on itself if it is underwater. The cloud heavily obscures the area until the end of the octopus’s next turn. A strong current can disperse it. The octopus can then swim up to its swim speed. If it swims, it immediately releases every creature it is grappling.

name: Octopus, Giant
otherStatistics: Str +3, Dex +1, Con +1, Int -3, Wis +0, Cha -3. Perception 14. Stealth 13. Darkvision 60 ft. Languages none.
appearance: A giant octopus with a bulbous mantle and long sucker-lined arms.

sections.Printed source: Cubil de Monstruos, licensed Nosolorol Spanish edition of Monster Vault, p. 352. Entry heading “Pulpo gigante”. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. Outside water, the octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour.
Underwater Camouflage. Underwater, its Stealth score is 18.
Water Breathing. The octopus breathes only underwater.
sections.Actions: Tentacles. Make a melee weapon attack at +5 against one target within 15 ft. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. A Huge or smaller creature hit is Grappled (escape DC 13) and Restrained until the grapple ends. The octopus can grapple up to two creatures at once.
sections.Bonus Actions: Tentacle Slam. Slam one Medium or smaller creature the octopus is grappling against a solid surface. The creature makes a DC 13 Strength save, taking 7 (2d6) bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Reactions: Ink Dash (Recharge 4–6). When a creature the octopus can see damages it, the octopus can release a 20-ft.-radius cloud of ink centered on itself if it is underwater. The cloud heavily obscures the area until the end of the octopus’s next turn. A strong current can disperse it. The octopus can then swim up to its swim speed. If it swims, it immediately releases every creature it is grappling.

name: Orca
otherStatistics: Str +4, Dex +0, Con +1, Int -4, Wis +1, Cha -2. Perception 13. Stealth 10. Natural armor. Resistant to cold damage. Keensense 120 ft. Languages none.
appearance: A black-and-white orca with a tall dorsal fin and broad tail flukes.

sections.Printed source: Cubil de Monstruos, licensed Nosolorol Spanish edition of Monster Vault, pp. 348–349. Entry heading “Orca”. https://www.nosolorol.com/talesofthevaliant
sections.Traits:
Echolocation. Deafened prevents the orca from using Keensense.
Heightened Hearing. Perception rises to 18 when relying on hearing.
Hold Breath. The orca can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make two Bite attacks.
Bite. Make a melee weapon attack at +6 against one creature within 5 ft. A hit deals 14 (3d6 + 4) piercing damage.
sections.Bonus Actions: Tail Slap. Choose one creature the orca can see within 15 ft. of its tail. The target makes a DC 14 Strength save. On a failure it is pushed up to 15 ft. away from the orca and knocked Prone. On a failure by 5 or more it is also Stunned until the end of its next turn.
